title: Homebrew Website Club Newsletter Volume 2 Issue 3 – Portland Edition | The World is not a desktop
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Bookmarked: Homebrew Website Club Newsletter Volume 2 Issue 3 – Portland Edition | The World is not a desktop

http://caseorganic.com/2014/02/homebrew-website-club-newsletter-volume-2-issue-3-portland-edition/

Amber Case explains the building block and not building for the masses anti-pattern as a a goal for resiliency

#el30 I worry about hypothetical cloud data. Document learning now instead of revolutionize learning later.

This is why I think it is exciting that the IndieWeb inherently follows this method. Work small, demo, integrate into the whole what works, and you get this emergent structure out of that that’s resilient, with things evolving at the edges out of people exploring new projects.
